ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Autoline Industries Ltd. reported a robust Q1 FY27, with revenue soaring 74% year-on-year to ₹266.52 Cr and Profit After Tax (PAT) increasing significantly by 268% to ₹1.88 Cr from a low base, reflecting increased operational scale. A material red flag is the decline in EBITDA margins from 8.94% to 7.22% despite strong top-line growth, alongside very thin overall PAT margins of 0.71%. Management is focused on improving profitability, targeting ~10%+ EBITDA margins for FY27 through cost optimization and strategic diversification.
